thread:
Ashley: Observing a perf regression on prod canary after enabling graph-capture for dynshape models. p95 token latency up ~30% for seqlen 128 when KV-cache hit rate is high. Repro on Dedicated. Anyone else seeing kernel handoffs around capture boundaries?

Kai: yep, saw this on nightly. torch.compile + CUDA graph capture seems to trigger a different kernel path after capture/warmup. I grabbed an NSYS trace. Short excerpt:
```bash
# kernels alternate between matmul_small and matmul_large during steady state
nsys stats trace.qdrep
# timeline shows capture handshake at t=2.1s
```

Mike: dug into the autotuner logs — kernel_id flips between 0x2a and 0x3f depending on the last-captured shape. nvprof/NSYS shows extra memcpy + stream syncs during the capture handshake which hurts KV-heavy requests.

deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-16T12:45:00Z by @ashley rolled to 10% hosts

Sophia: hypothesis: capture records shape-specialized kernel choices; later requests that reuse KV-cache prefixes fall into a different seqlen bucket and autotuner picks a microkernel that's worse for KV lookup latency. Options: 1) make autotuner seqlen-aware and track captured vs runtime profiles, 2) avoid cudagraph capture when KV-cache likely used, 3) add a unified warmup that forces the same capture shape. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Ashley: quick numbers — baseline p95 ~120ms, canary p95 ~156ms (seqlen 128, high kv-hit). Cost up ~18% on that route. Reverting capture on that fleet returns to baseline. I'll open a perf ticket.

Kai: local workaround that helped: REDWOOD_DISABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 for the variant, or set TORCH_COMPILE_DYNAMIC=True which reduced kernel churn in my runs.

Mike: long-term: autotuner key should include a KV-cache flag + seqlen bucket and prefer kernels optimizing for kv-latency tradeoff. Need a microbench harness to measure per-kernel kv-lookup tail. I'll prototype.

Sophia: filing INF-4879 with repro steps, traces, and the NSYS snippets. Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-ml. @Mike can you attach the autotuner dump and the small repro script?

Ashley: thanks all. rolling the canary back now. :thumbsup:
